name: data-grid
title: Data Grid
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: A data grid driven by a TanStack Table instance (`useReactTable`) and rendered with react-aria's `Table`, which brings cell keyboard navigation, `aria-sort`, selection, column resizing, row drag and drop and virtualization. Wrap parts in `DataGrid table={table} recordCount={…}`: `DataGridTable`, `DataGridPagination`, `DataGridColumnHeader` (sort indicator, plus a menu for pinning, moving and visibility when `tableLayout` enables them), `DataGridColumnVisibility`, `DataGridColumnFilter` (faceted, use `filterFn: "arrIncludesSome"`), `DataGridRowSelect` (with `enableRowSelection`), `DataGridRowPin` and `DataGridRowDragHandle` (with `onRowsReorder`). Sorting is wired when the table has `getSortedRowModel` or `manualSorting`. `isLoading` shows skeleton rows (`meta.skeleton`) or a spinner; `meta.autoSize` columns take the remaining width.

meta.origin: reui.io (https://reui.io/docs/components/base/data-grid, MIT), via EMITTE; rendering rebuilt on react-aria Table
